paper_title: Copper-catalyzed aerobic oxidation of aldehydes to carboxylic acids†

questions.question: In this paper, what does the label '1a' refer to?
What is the product identity/structure of compound 2a formed from 1a under the standard conditions?
Under the reported standard Cu/TEMPO catalytic conditions (e.g., conversion of 1a to 2a), what solvent and atmosphere/oxidant were used?
questions.ground_truth_answer: DCE (1,2-dichloroethane) as solvent and O2 (oxygen) supplied as an O2 balloon (ambient O2); catalysts: Cu(NO3)2·3H2O (10 mol%) and TEMPO (10 mol%) at room temperature

questions.question: Which gave the higher yield for oxidation of 1a: the standard reaction with Cu(NO3)2·3H2O/TEMPO (Table 1, entry 1) or the reaction carried out without Cu(NO3)2·3H2O (Table 1, entry 15)?
questions.ground_truth_answer: The standard reaction with Cu(NO3)2·3H2O/TEMPO gave the higher yield (86%); the reaction without Cu(NO3)2·3H2O gave 0% yield.
